status:
Load test of the public API, 5 minutes at each rate from 100 to 600 requests a second.

With the limiter, p95 latency stays under 120 ms at every rate, and requests over the limit get a `429` at once. Before it, p95 passed 700 ms at 600 requests a second.

![p95 latency under load](attachment:latency.png)
